test_action_space_forward: test that ActionSpace forwards sample, seed, and contains calls to the wrapped action space
test_action_space_comparison: test that ActionSpace equality compares against the wrapped action space object
test_discrete_to_string: test that Discrete action space converts action lists to comma-separated string format
test_named_discrete_to_string: test that NamedDiscrete action space converts action indices to space-separated named item strings
test_action_space_str: test that ActionSpace string representation shows the wrapped space name in parentheses
